name: Portico Employee Enrollment
description: Single focused dashboard for Portico's own ~200 employees, for HR: headline completion stats plus a full per-employee table, sorted so anyone needing follow-up shows up first. Built 2026-10-01 after Blair pointed out that mirroring the full 3-widget general-member suite was overkill for a population this small.

feeds.description: Same model/shape as sac-member-detail-widget's memberDetail binding -- Member / Wave / Enrollment_Status / Defaulted / Defaulted_Timing / Membership_Type / Member_Health_Coverage / Vision_Plan / Set_Up_Date / Completed_Date / Abandoned_Date / Is_Portico_Employee, from GLD_AE_Member_Enrollment directly (row-level, PII-bearing) via AM_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_DETAIL. This widget filters to Is_Portico_Employee = 'Yes' (opposite of the main suite's exclusion) and shows every matching row directly -- no Input Control needed, population is small enough (~200) to list in full.

Total_Attempts, HSA_Election_Amount, FSA_Health_Election_Amount, FSA_Dependent_Election_Amount, SuppLife_Member_Amount, SuppLife_Spouse_Amount, SuppLife_Dependent_Amount, Retirement_Pretax_Amount, Retirement_Roth_Amount, Eligible_Count, Health_Covered_Count -- in that exact order. The last two (Eligible_Count/Health_Covered_Count) are already on AM_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_DETAIL but not yet used by sac-member-detail-widget itself -- added here per Blair's request. Still NULL in real Gold pending BR-29 (vDimMember fan-out fix).

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
